item.title: Cruise Ship Capsizes After Tanker Collision in New Orleans
item.description: All passengers and crew members aboard a river cruise ship that capsized after a tanker collision in New Orleans on Friday were accounted for, with 32 people hospitalized but none critically injured, according to Mayor Helena Moreno. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: US Flights Grounded Over Air Traffic Communication Issue
item.description: US authorities halted flights nationwide due to communication issues affecting air traffic control. Myles Miller reports from LaGuardia Airport. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia’s Board CEO Hunt, Stocks Finish Week Higher, Retail in Focus
item.description: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Franklin Templeton Institute’s Head Market Strategist Chris Galipeau, Pershing Square’s Founder and CEO Bill Ackman, London Business School Leadership Institute’s Founding Director Randall Peterson, Committee For A Responsible Federal Budget’s President Maya MacGuineas, Real Macro’s CEO and Founder Jeff Currie, Northwestern Mutual Wealth’s Chief Portfolio Manager of Equities Matt Stucky, National Academy of Engineering’s President Tse-Jae King Liu, Exemplar Luxury Group’s CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck, Rent the Runway’s President and CEO Paige Thomas, Grammy Award Winning Singer and Hinote’s Co-Founder Carrie Underwood, Hinote’s CEO and Co-Founder Kerrigan Behrens. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Troubled Sherritt Misses Payment as Liquidity Crisis Deepens
item.description: Sherritt International Corp. missed an interest payment on secured notes, deepening a liquidity crisis for the troubled Canadian miner hobbled by US sanctions that forced it to halt production in Cuba.
item.dc:creator: Sybilla Gross

item.title: Carrie Underwood on Her New Wellness Brand, HiNote
item.description: Carrie Underwood and HiNote CEO and co-founder Kerrigan Behrens discuss the wellness brand’s origins and plans to grow production of its flagship drink mix following a new investment. They speak with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on “The Close” (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia’s Board Failed Jensen Huang: Randall Peterson
item.description: Randall Peterson, founding director of the London Business School Leadership Institute, believes the board of Nvidia failed both the company and Huang. He speaks with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on “The Close”. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Exemplar Luxury Group CEO on the Company’s Second Life
item.description: Geoffroy van Raemdonck said Exemplar Luxury Group is financially stronger after Saks emerged from bankruptcy. He emphasized reaching that goal through customer loyalty, full-price sales and profitable growth that supports reinvestment and strengthens relationships with brands. Geoffroy van Raemdonck speaks with Romaine Bostick on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Big Take: The Climate Is Changing in Ways Models Couldn’t Predict
item.description: COP31 aims to set new goals to bring down emissions as climate change outpaces scientists’ predictions and disasters drive billions of dollars of losses. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Jeff Currie Says He’s Bearish on Copper Due to China
item.description:
Jeff Currie, CEO and founder at Real Macro and senior adviser at Carlyle, says gold’s retreat reflects a shortage of dollar liquidity. He also discusses the global oil industry in an interview with Vonnie Quinn and Bailey Lipschultz on “The Close.”
(Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Rent the Runway CEO Paige Thomas on Her Company Vision
item.description: Rent the Runway CEO Paige Thomas sits down with Romaine Bostick to discuss her vision for the company since taking over the helm two months ago, how she plans to strategize the company’s business and more. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Tanker Hits Cruise Ship in New Orleans, Triggering Rescue
item.description: A tanker collided with a docked river cruise ship on the Mississippi River in New Orleans, leaving the smaller vessel partly submerged and setting off a rescue operation. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Flights Grounded Across US Over Air Traffic Control Problems
item.description: US authorities halted flights nationwide due to communication issues affecting air traffic control, an extraordinary action that threatens to disrupt travel across the globe. The Federal Aviation Administration said in an advisory notice on its website on Friday that the ground stop affects all US airports and departing flights should remain grounded until further notice. It cited “extraordinary circumstances” and “reasons of safety.” Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head Aerospace, Defense & Airline Analysis reacts to the ongoing situation saying the ground stop is about de-conflicting traffic. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: US is Struggling to Build Affordable Housing
item.description: America’s housing affordability crisis may be about more than high mortgage rates and restrictive zoning. Boston Fed Principal Economist and Policy Advisor Paul Willen says soaring construction costs are making many new housing projects financially unworkable, even after they’ve already won approval. He points to research showing construction productivity has barely improved in decades, even as productivity across much of the rest of the economy has surged. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Investing in Financial Security: Masters in Business with Salim Ramji
item.description: Barry speaks with Vanguard CEO Salim Ramji. They discuss his early career journey in law before transitioning to BlackRock as Head of Corporate Strategy and later taking over as the first "outsider" CEO of Vanguard. They also discuss Vanguard's recent acquisition of Altruist and what it means for the future of financial advice. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Flights Halted Across US, FAA Cites Safety Reasons
item.description: US authorities halted flights nationwide due to communication issues affecting air traffic control. Will Guisbond reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: FAA Grounds All Flights Nationwide
item.description: All flights in the US have been grounded. The Federal Aviation Administration cited “extraordinary circumstances” and “reasons of safety” for the ground stop, which affects all US airports. Bloomberg's Will Guisbond is following this breaking news. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Salim Ramji on the Vanguard Effect
item.description: Barry speaks with Vanguard CEO Salim Ramji. They discuss his early career journey in law before transitioning to BlackRock as Head of Corporate Strategy and later taking over as the first "outsider" CEO of Vanguard. They also discuss Vanguard's recent acquisition of Altruist and what it means for the future of financial advice. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Has Worst Week Since Trump Tariff Selloff as Huang Exits
item.description: Nvidia Corp. stock notched its worst week in more than 18 months, as its share price continued to reel after Jensen Huang’s ouster from the top chipmaker.
item.dc:creator: Carmen Reinicke

item.title: Bond Investors Expect More Pain After Week of Soaring Yields
item.description: Just when global bond investors were starting to believe the worst of this year’s selloff was over, surging Treasury yields are making them think again.
item.dc:creator: Ruth Carson, Masaki Kondo and Greg Ritchie

item.title: Emerging-Market Assets Dip as Chip Rout, Fed Rate Worries Linger
item.description: Emerging-market assets fell on Friday as a rout in chipmakers weighed on equities and lingering concerns over the Federal Reserve’s rate path kept currencies under pressure.
item.dc:creator: Giovanna Bellotti Azevedo, Bhaskar Dutta and Suvashree Ghosh
